items.title: 6.5.1 Rule for nth term of a G.P. (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Pichle sabaq mein aap ne seekha ke G.P. mein har agli term pichli term ko \(r\) se zarb dene se milti hai. Lekin sochiye, agar humein 20vin ya 50vin term chahiye ho to kya hum 49 dafa zarb karte rahenge? Bilkul nahin. Is sabaq mein hum aik formula banayenge jo seedha \(n^{\text{th}}\) term de de, jaise A.P. mein \(a_n = a_1 + (n-1)d\) tha.

Kitab kehti hai: pehli term ke baad har term apni pichli term ka \(r\) guna (multiple) hai. Ab qadam ba qadam dekhte hain:
\[a_2 = a_1 r = a_1 r^{2-1}\]
\[a_3 = a_2 r = (a_1 r)r\]
\[= a_1 r^{2} = a_1 r^{3-1}\]
\[a_4 = a_3 r = (a_1 r^{2})r\]
\[= a_1 r^{3} = a_1 r^{4-1}\]
\[\vdots\]
Har line mein hum ne pichli term ki jagah us ki value rakhi aur aik \(r\) aur multiply kiya. Ab pattern pehchaaniye: \(a_2\) mein \(r\) ki power 1, \(a_3\) mein 2, \(a_4\) mein 3. Yani power hamesha position se aik kam hai. Isi pattern ko \(n\)vin term tak le jayein to

blocks.text_alt: a n equals a 1 times r to the power n minus 1

blocks.text: Yeh G.P. ki general term (aam term ka formula) hai. Is mein \(n\) ki jagah koi bhi number rakh kar woh term seedhi mil jati hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Power \(n - 1\) kyun, \(n\) kyun nahin? Socho aap seedhiyan chadh rahe hain: pehli seedhi par khare hain, paanchvin par jana hai to sirf chaar qadam lene parenge. Isi tarah pehli term se \(n\)vin term tak \(r\) se sirf \(n - 1\) dafa zarb hota hai, kyun ke \(n\) terms ke beech \(n - 1\) faasle (jumps) hote hain.
A.P. se muqabla kariye: \(a_n = a_1 + (n-1)d\). Wahan \(d\) ko \(n - 1\) dafa jora jata hai, is liye \(d\) ko \(n - 1\) se zarb milta hai. Yahan \(r\) ko \(n - 1\) dafa zarb kiya jata hai, is liye \(r\) ki power \(n - 1\) ban jati hai. Baar baar jorna = zarb; baar baar zarb = power. Yeh aik hi idea ki do shaklein hain.

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
Yeh hamari taraf se practice hai, kitab ka sawal nahin. \(a_1 = 2\) aur \(r = 3\) ho to 5vin term kya hogi?
\[a_5 = 2 \cdot 3^{5-1} = 2 \cdot 81 = 162\]
Tasdeeq ke liye terms likh kar dekhiye: \(2, 6, 18, 54, 162\). Paanchvin term 162 hi hai. Formula ka faida yeh hai ke \(a_{20}\) bhi seedha nikal aata hai, saari terms likhe baghair.
Aik aur: \(a_1 = 64\), \(r = \frac{1}{2}\) ho to \(a_7 = 64 \cdot \left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^{6} = \frac{64}{64} = 1\).
Khud sochiye: \(a_1 = 5\), \(r = 2\) ho to \(a_6\) kya hogi? (Jawab: \(5 \cdot 2^{5} = 160\).)

blocks.title: Exam tip
blocks.text:
Is formula mein chaar cheezein hain: \(a_1, r, n, a_n\). Koi teen maloom hon to chauthi nikal aati hai. Is liye sawal parhte hi likh lein ke kya diya hai aur kya chahiye.
Jab \(r\) negative ya fraction ho to use hamesha bracket mein rakhein: \((-2)^{7}\), \(\left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^{6}\). Yaad rakhein: negative number ki even (juft) power positive aur odd (taaq) power negative hoti hai.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. G.P. ki general term: \(a_n = a_1 r^{n-1}\).
2. \(r\) ki power term ki position se aik kam hoti hai.
3. Power sirf \(r\) par lagti hai; \(a_1\) baad mein zarb hota hai.
4. \(a_1, r, n, a_n\) mein se teen maloom hon to chauthi nikal aati hai.
5. Negative \(r\) hamesha bracket mein.

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. \(a_n = a_1 r^{n}\) likh dena: power \(n - 1\) hai. Bachne ka tareeqa: \(n = 1\) rakh kar dekhein; \(a_1 = a_1 r^{0} = a_1\) aana chahiye.
2. \((a_1 r)^{n-1}\) likhna: power sirf \(r\) par hai, \(a_1\) par nahin.
3. \(r = -2\) ho to \(-2^{7}\) likh dena: is ka matlab \(-(2^{7})\) hai; sahi \((-2)^{7}\) hai. Even power par yeh farq jawab ka sign badal deta hai.
